WHITMORE — births, from the parish register of the Church of St. Thaddeus, Bellweather (Mercer copy):

Julian Edward Whitmore, b. 4 March 1890, s. of Dr. Edward Whitmore. Physician. Seat: IV, Medicine, from 1921.
Agnes Whitmore, b. 1894.

Facing page, cut out with a blade: a rectangle the size of one entry. Pencilled beside the hole, in Arthur's hand: "Not a Whitmore. The family they cut out of everybody's book."
